Title: New Zealand Dollar $1k build, opinions please. - PCPartPicker
URL: https://no.pcpartpicker.com/forums/topic/171099-new-zealand-dollar-1k-build-opinions-please
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
I put together this build from retail stores in New Zealand and it comes out to just under $1'000 Although when entered into PCPP it comes to $600 USD (damn NZ taxs)

Anywho, I am just wondering what you guys think of it.

The only part that I couldn't find on here was the PSU, the one I have is a FSP Group Hexa+ 500Watt unit. its pretty basic but seems ok enough for this build. I know never to skimp on a PSU but this is the best I could scrounge up with 1K$

The build is solely for gaming/internet browsing etc. (you know the basic jazz) Games playing will be pretty well anything at hopefully Max (or close to) settings pushing mid to high 50fps
